verdict.rationale: Unit publishes a live llms.txt (probe HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at it. Its content, however, is a high-level product and marketing overview (accounts, payments, cards, lending) rather than agent-usable API documentation, and the probes found no markdown docs or OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: llms.txt content covering API endpoints and integration guidance, markdown versions of the API docs (docs .md returned 404), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Companies can build directly on the Unit Platform using APIs and components, with control over their product experience and operating model.
